name: pr-guardian
description: AI + Semgrep code review for pull requests, with Gemini or Groq as the LLM.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
